explanation: I grepped Mathlib for withDensity equality and injectivity lemmas. The only close match is `withDensity_eq_iff_of_sigmaFinite`, which sits right next to the target in the same file. It assumes `SigmaFinite μ` and has no finiteness hypothesis on `∫⁻ f`. The target assumes `∫⁻ f ≠ ∞` instead and has no sigma-finiteness assumption on `μ`. That finiteness hypothesis does not imply `SigmaFinite μ`, so the sigma-finite lemma does not apply to the target's setting. Every other hit is a use of one of these two lemmas, not an independent statement of the same result.
